item.title: China insta a los países a frenar las tendencias históricas regresivas
item.description: El ministro de Defensa de China, Dong Jun, instó el miércoles a las naciones a evitar actos provocadores y frenar el resurgimiento de tendencias históricas regresivas, en comentarios que probablemente serán interpretados como una crítica velada a Japón.
item.dc:creator: Mei Mei Chu
item.content:encoded: El ministro de Defensa de China, Dong Jun, instó el miércoles a las naciones a evitar actos provocadores y frenar el resurgimiento de tendencias históricas regresivas, en comentarios que probablemente serán interpretados como una crítica velada a Japón. Las declaraciones de Dong en el Foro Xiangshan de Pekín sobre seguridad se producen en un momento de fuertes tensiones regionales por Taiwán, reclamado por China, y por la disputada vía marítima del mar de China Meridional, mientras crecen las dudas sobre los compromisos de seguridad tradicionales de Estados Unidos con Asia. Al advertir que el mundo ha llegado a un “momento delicado”, Dong pidió un enfoque más renovado y equitativo para resolver las tensiones internacionales, aunque ofreció pocos detalles concretos o críticas directas a sus rivales. “Debemos tener presentes las lecciones de la historia y mantenernos muy vigilantes ante todas las manifestaciones latentes de hegemonía, militarismo y revisionismo histórico”, dijo en su discurso de apertura. “No debemos hacer la vista gorda ni tolerar ese comportamiento. Movilizando amplias fuerzas de justicia, debemos reprimir el resurgimiento de los residuos del pasado histórico y evitar que aprovechen la situación para causar daño”. SIN CRÍTICAS DIRECTAS A ESTADOS UNIDOS NI A SUS ALIADOS REGIONALES Tal y como predijeron algunos analistas, Dong evitó las críticas directas a Estados Unidos o a sus aliados regionales, como Japón, y pareció ceñirse estrictamente a las posiciones que China mantiene desde hace tiempo. “No debemos mostrar indulgencia hacia actos provocadores que buscan secuestrar los intereses generales de los países de la región en beneficio propio o de determinados grupos, y debemos trabajar juntos para contenerlos”, añadió. Los comentarios llegan una semana antes de que el presidente chino, Xi Jinping, viaje previsiblemente a Estados Unidos para una cumbre con el presidente Donald Trump. Las relaciones entre China y Japón se deterioraron gravemente el año pasado después de que la primera ministra japonesa, Sanae Takaichi, sugiriera que un hipotético ataque chino contra Taiwán podría desencadenar una respuesta militar japonesa. Esto llevó a Pekín a advertir en repetidas ocasiones de que Japón estaba tratando de volver a su pasado agresivo. China considera que Taiwán, gobernado democráticamente, forma parte de su territorio y ha intensificado la presión militar en torno a la isla, lo que incluye la realización periódica de maniobras militares. El Gobierno de Taiwán rechaza las reivindicaciones soberanistas de Pekín. Alrededor de 2.000 oficiales militares, diplomáticos y académicos de decenas de países participan en el evento de tres días, que se prolongará hasta el jueves.

item.title: 午後3時のドルは155円前半、原油高で一時買い優勢も 次第に様子見
item.description:
Hiroko Hamada
[東京 １６日 ロイター] -
ド...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
午後3時のドルは155円前半、原油高で一時買い優勢も　次第に様子見 15:31 配信

米ドル紙幣。２０１６年１１月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Hiroko Hamada

[東京 １６日 ロイター] -

ドル／円 ユーロ／ドル ユーロ／円

午後３時現在 155.18／155.20 1.1549／1.1551 179.23／179.24

午前９時現在 155.28／155.30 1.1536／1.1538 179.14／179.15

ＮＹ午後５時 155.08／155.11 1.1541／1.1544 178.98／179.04

午後３時のドル／円は、前日ニューヨーク市場終盤とほぼ横ばいの１５５円前半で推移している。原油価格の上昇基調を受けてドル買いが進み、午前の取引では一時１５５円半ばまで上昇した。ただ、日本時間の１７日未明に米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）の結果公表を控え、次第に様子見ムードも広がった。

朝方１５５円前半で推移していたドルは一時、１５５．４９円に上昇。原油価格が高止まりする中、先々のインフレを警戒する動きが強まったとの声があった。足元でレジスタンスとして意識されていた１５５．２０―３０円台を上抜けたことで、トレンドが上昇に転じたとの見方も聞かれた。

１６日付読売新聞は、１７日に見込まれる内閣改造で城内実成長戦略相の続投が有力と報じた。内閣改造でリフレ色が薄まるかが市場の注目の一つだったため、既に続投が報じられている片山さつき財務相と併せ、「留任であれば、市場への影響はなさそうだ」（国内銀の為替ディーラー）との声が聞かれた。

午後の取引では狭い値幅での動きが続いた。ＦＯＭＣの結果公表を控える中で、手掛けにくさも意識された。マネックス証券のチーフ・ＦＸコンサルタント、吉田恒氏はＦＯＭＣについて、「利上げを実施しても、見送った場合でも、特に債券市場や株式市場は荒れる可能性がある」と指摘する。仮に利上げを見送った場合は、「ビハインド・ザ・カーブが意識されて長期金利が急騰するリスクがある」と話す。一方、株式市場は利上げを嫌気して売りが出るのではないか、という。

吉田氏は「特に最近の為替相場は一つの材料で過敏に反応する傾向があるので、イベント後の動きに警戒したい」と話した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：石油価格、イラン攻撃による急騰から持久戦へ コラム：ホルムズ封鎖で石油貿易に変化、米州が最大の受益者に アングル：世界の石油備蓄、イラン戦争長期化による大規模供給途絶を乗り切れるか 焦点：エジプト沖ドローン攻撃が脅かす原油輸送代替ルート、スエズ運河巡る安全性に懸念 アングル：原油価格、イラン紛争でも予想ほど急騰しなかった訳 最終更新: 9/16(水) 15:31 ロイター

item.title: La inflación de Reino Unido se acelera hasta el 3,1%, pero el índice subyacente se mantiene estable
item.description: La inflación británica se aceleró en agosto hasta alcanzar un máximo de cinco meses, situándose en el 3,1% frente al 2,9% registrado en julio, revelaron las cifras oficiales un día antes de que se conozca si el Banco de Inglaterra mantiene las tasas de interés sin cambios a pesar del aumento de las presiones sobre los precios.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La inflación británica se aceleró en agosto hasta alcanzar un máximo de cinco meses, situándose en el 3,1% frente al 2,9% registrado en julio, revelaron las cifras oficiales un día antes de que se conozca si el Banco de Inglaterra mantiene las tasas de interés sin cambios a pesar del aumento de las presiones sobre los precios. El aumento de agosto coincidió con la previsión media de los economistas encuestados por Reuters, quienes pronosticaron que la inflación de los precios al consumo se aceleraría debido a un nuevo repunte de los precios de la energía provocado por la reanudación del conflicto en el golfo Pérsico. El Banco de Inglaterra pronosticó en julio que la inflación interanual se situaría en el 2,8% en agosto. La libra esterlina cayó ligeramente tras la publicación de las cifras de inflación el miércoles. A pesar de que la tasa de inflación general ha resultado ser superior a lo que esperaba el banco central, es probable que los dirigentes monetarios presten más atención a los indicadores subyacentes del crecimiento de los precios, que se ven menos afectados de forma inmediata por el repunte de los costos energéticos. La Oficina Nacional de Estadística (ONS, por sus siglas en inglés) reveló que su indicador de inflación subyacente —que excluye partidas volátiles como los alimentos y los combustibles— se mantuvo en el 2,6% por cuarto mes consecutivo en agosto. La inflación en el sector de los servicios británico —un indicador que el Banco de Inglaterra (BoE) sigue de cerca, ya que refleja el crecimiento salarial y las presiones inflacionistas a largo plazo— también se mantuvo sin cambios en el 3,4%. Los datos de la ONS publicados el martes mostraron que el crecimiento salarial se mantuvo cerca de su nivel más bajo desde 2020. Los inversionistas estiman que hay una probabilidad de un 33% de que el Banco de Inglaterra suba las tasas un cuarto de punto el jueves. Sin embargo, se dan por hechas dos subidas antes de que finalice 2026, en un contexto de preocupación por el riesgo de que el repunte de los costos energéticos impulse al alza los precios de forma más generalizada.

item.title: Los aeropuertos españoles de Aena registraron 34,9 millones de pasajeros en agosto
item.description: Unos 34,9 millones de pasajeros pasaron por los aeropuertos españoles de Aena en agosto, un 4,7% más que en el mismo mes del año pasado, según informó el martes el operador aeroportuario.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Unos 34,9 millones de pasajeros pasaron por los aeropuertos españoles de Aena (AENA.MC) en agosto, un 4,7% más que en el mismo mes del año pasado, según informó el martes el operador aeroportuario. El aumento del número de pasajeros pone de relieve la resistencia de España como centro turístico, incluso en un momento en que el sector aéreo mundial se enfrenta a la inestabilidad geopolítica, los retrasos en la entrega de aviones, la escasez de mano de obra y el aumento de los costes operativos, factores que han limitado el crecimiento de la capacidad en otros lugares. El número de pasajeros en los primeros ocho meses de 2026 alcanzó los 225,5 millones, un 4,1% más que hace un año El Aeropuerto Adolfo Suárez Madrid-Barajas siguió siendo el más transitado de España, seguido por el Josep Tarradellas Barcelona-El Prat y el de Palma de Mallorca Todos los aeropuertos gestionados por Aena —46 aeropuertos y dos helipuertos en España, 17 aeropuertos en Brasil, así como el de Luton, en Londres, y el Leeds Bradford— registraron un aumento del 4,7%, hasta alcanzar los 41,4 millones de pasajeros en agosto

item.title: US, Vietnam firms to sign agreements as To Lam travels to New York, documents show
item.description: A string of agreements is expected to be announced next week by U.S. and Vietnamese corporations involving energy, tech, aviation and financial firms as Vietnam's leader To Lam travels to New York, according to officials and two documents reviewed by Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Phuong Nguyen, Francesco Guarascio
item.content:encoded: A string of agreements is expected to be announced next week by U.S. and Vietnamese corporations involving energy, tech, aviation and financial firms as Vietnam's leader To Lam travels to New York, according to officials and two documents reviewed by Reuters. Commercial agreements, many of which are expected to be non-binding, have been for months part of [USN:L4N3PX005 TEXT:"Vietnam's strategy"] to mollify Washington as the Trump administration is threatening new tariffs on the export-reliant Southeast Asian nation. One internal planning note lists 29 agreements that could be announced on September 23 in New York at a business conference to be attended by To Lam. U.S. energy firms Murphy Oil (MUR.N) and Chevron (CVX.N) are expected to announce agreements with state-owned Petrovietnam, while ExxonMobil (XOM.N) is slated to announce an accord with Vietnam Refinery and Petrochemical Corporation (BSR.HM) , the country's second-largest refinery. In February the refinery signed a non-binding oil supply agreement with Chevron, but no subsequent purchase was announced. Murphy Oil is active in oil and gas explorations in Vietnam, while ExxonMobil operates the country's largest gas field which remains however untapped. The agreements are to be announced on To Lam's last day in New York before [USN:L6N44V0HL TEXT:"he travels to Canada "]for a state visit. He is expected to speak at the U.N. General Assembly on September 22 and hold meetings with several U.S. corporations, three officials said. His schedule has not yet been officially announced. His trip is also aimed at making progress on trade talks with the United States, and possibly to agree on a trade deal which has been negotiated for more than a year, two of the officials said. However, a meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump is not certain, the sources said. Trump's schedule was not yet confirmed, a White House official said on Tuesday. Vietnam's foreign ministry nor any of the companies cited in this article immediately responded to requests for comment, some out of their business hours. AVIATION, TECH The document, which may be subject to changes and does not indicate the content of the planned agreements, also lists several deals involving Vietnam's largest private airline, Vietjet (VJC.HM) , including with aviation partners and SpaceX (SPCX.O) . The company is expected to announce the leasing of as many as 22 planes from four aviation leasing companies, including 17 Boeing (BA.N) 737 jets and five Airbus (AIR.PA) A321neo, according to a separate document from Vietjet. The planned contract with SpaceX is for the provision of satellite internet services from Starlink to 120 Vietjet aircraft, according to the Vietjet document. The airline also plans to sign memoranda of understanding with U.S. jet engine maintenance firms, according to the documents. The provisional list also includes an unspecified agreement between Meta (META.O) and Vietnam's ministry of culture, and a separate agreement between U.S. chip giant Qualcomm (QCOM.O) with Vietnamese telecom firm VNPT. Qualcomm is already active in the rollout of Vietnam's 5G network, while Meta's Facebook is the most popular social media in the Communist-ruled nation. Visa (V.N) , Mastercard (MA.N) and Citibank (C.N) are also expected to announce agreements with financial and hospitality partners in Vietnam, according to the document.

item.title: UK's Babcock retains annual forecast as defence spending backs momentum
item.description: British defence and engineering group Babcock International reaffirmed its full-year outlook on Wednesday on the back of strong momentum across its marine, nuclear and land businesses amid higher defence spending.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British defence and engineering group Babcock International (BAB.L) reaffirmed its full-year outlook on Wednesday on the back of strong momentum across its marine, nuclear and land businesses amid higher defence spending. Here are some details from its trading update: The company, which maintains Britain's naval fleet, provides weapons systems and supports nuclear projects, said its performance was supported by strong demand across core defence and nuclear markets Babcock's update comes amid defence firms reaping benefits of militaries rearming heavily against heightened geopolitical tensions and the Iran war. The firm which has several contracts with the British military said it was awaiting further details on the government's expanded defence investment after a £15 billion ($20.22 billion) [USN:L1N43205S TEXT:"plan"] was laid out in June in a boost for domestic suppliers. Analysts per a company-provided poll expect Babcock to log 2027 sales of £5.49 billion and an underlying operating profit of £464 million, up from year ago's £5.19 billion and £293 million, respectively. Larger rival BAE Systems (BAES.L) in July raised its 2026 profit outlook on soaring defence orders. ($1 = 0.7418 pounds)

item.title: India's NSE to launch IPO amid investor caution over derivatives-fuelled growth
item.description: The National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) will launch its $2.3 billion public offering on Wednesday amid investor caution over capital market firms because of declining derivative trading volumes, which have already impacted the offer price.
item.dc:creator: Jayshree Pyasi, Vivek M, Ankur Banerjee
item.content:encoded: The National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) will launch its $2.3 billion public offering on Wednesday amid investor caution over capital market firms because of declining derivative trading volumes, which have already impacted the offer price. The IPO for India's biggest bourse — set to be the country's third-largest ever — will begin with anchor investor bidding from institutional funds and is an offer-for-sale from existing private shareholders with no new capital being raised. Open subscriptions will begin on Thursday and close on September 21. Investors are being asked to value the world's largest derivatives bourse at a time when its biggest growth engine is slowing down, raising questions about how much of the exchange’s extraordinary derivatives-driven growth can continue. The NSE shares will be offered in a price band of 1,700 to 1,785 Indian rupees ($17.72 to $18.60), [USN:L4N4521GX TEXT:"valuing"] the company at $46 billion, public filings showed on September 11. However, that is 15% to 20% lower than the valuation sought in pre-deal roadshows, according to two sources with direct knowledge of the matter who spoke on condition of anonymity, and is 40% lower than what private markets sales of NSE shares in 2024 indicated. Investors are reluctant to pay higher prices because of [USN:L4N43G0S4 TEXT:"regulatory changes"] that have slowed growth in options trading and an overhaul of [USN:L4N44A0T5 TEXT:"trading rules"] to align Indian markets with global standards. The NSE gains 80% of its revenue from trading of which 60% is options trading and those volumes have dropped 27% from their peak in 2024. "NSE's high exposure to derivatives is a double-edged sword. Its dominant liquidity pool and scale are clear competitive strengths, but they also make earnings more sensitive to regulatory changes and shifts in trading activity," said Gary Tan, portfolio manager at Allspring Global Investments. Still, even at this valuation, NSE would be among the top 10 largest listed exchanges globally. At the lowered offer price, several global institutional investors, including sovereign wealth funds and long-only asset managers, have provided commitments, the two sources with knowledge of the matter said. That includes Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, Singapore's GIC, Fidelity, Carmignac, Norges Bank Investment Management and Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC), they said. GIC, Norges, ADIA, Carmignac and Fidelity declined to comment when contacted by Reuters, while queries sent to LIC were not answered. In a press conference on Saturday, Sriram Krishnan, chief business development officer at NSE, pointed to a disconnect between the offer price and current shareholder expectations. "Some of the shareholders feel that the NSE's valuation is much more than the valuation at which we are proposing to do the IPO. To them NSE is more [USN:L4N45209D TEXT:"valuable"]. There is some money on the table, possibly." OPTIONS SLOWDOWN TESTS VALUATION The NSE has seen a bottom-line impact from its reduced derivative trading volumes. The exchange's revenue from operations fell 3.1% in the fiscal year ending March 2026, while profit dropped 15.5%. According to Bernstein, Indian equity derivatives volumes are entering a phase of normalisation and they forecast growth will slow to about 5% in the fiscal year ending in 2027 due to regulatory measures on options trading. Still, the NSE's IPO valuation implies a forward earnings multiple of 35 to 38 times FY2028 earnings, higher than the 23 to 31 times earnings global exchange operators Nasdaq, CME Group, Deutsche Börse, HKEX and LSEG currently trade. "The current pricing is factoring, options trading slowdown due to regulatory tightening and initial teething issues in the new mechanism to determine [USN:L4N4570CO TEXT:"closing prices"]. Perhaps had the IPO launched at any other time, valuation could have been better," said Anubhav Dayal, founder of Hong Kong-headquartered fund manager Soach Global Corporation. His flagship fund is selling 20% of its NSE holding in the offering. In the past 15 months, the NSE has launched electricity futures, electronic gold receipts, natural gas futures and incorporated a national coal exchange. On Saturday, NSE's Krishnan pointed to these efforts as positives that outweigh any short-term concerns around derivative volumes. "In the longer term, there will be so much diversification of revenue and as a natural consequence people will forget this current focus on index options," he said. ($1 = 95.9500 Indian rupees)

item.title: Malaysia talks to rival airlines as it monitors AirAsia's financial health, sources say
item.description: Malaysia Airlines and Batik Air have both expressed their willingness to expand organically to absorb AirAsia's routes and passengers rather than acquire its whole business, sources said.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Asia

Malaysia talks to rival airlines as it monitors AirAsia's financial health, sources say

Malaysia Airlines and Batik Air have both expressed their willingness to expand organically to absorb AirAsia's routes and passengers rather than acquire its whole business, sources said.

AirAsia planes stand on the tarmac at Kuala Lumpur International Airport Terminal 2 in Sepang, Malaysia, on Jan 21, 2026. (File photo: Reuters/Hasnoor Hussain)

FAST

KUALA LUMPUR/HONG KONG: Malaysia's government has asked Malaysia Airlines and Batik Air whether they can absorb AirAsia's domestic market share, said two people with knowledge of the matter, as part of what they described as scenario planning while authorities monitor the financial health of Southeast Asia's largest low-cost airline. Discussions between the government and Malaysia Airlines and Batik Air have increased in recent weeks, the people said, amid growing concerns over financial pressures faced by AirAsia. The airline has been hit by soaring jet fuel costs stemming from the US-Israeli war on Iran that surged 66 per cent in the second quarter from the prior quarter to an average of US$183 a barrel.  The talks, which involve the finance ministry and state-linked airport operator Malaysia Airports Holdings, are part of broader scenario planning around AirAsia's financial strains, the people said.

Other options that have been discussed include the government providing some form of endorsement to bolster the airline's plan to raise fresh capital from external investors, though the exact nature of any potential support remains unclear, Reuters reported this month. Reuters was unable to independently establish details about AirAsia's financial picture. Malaysia Airlines and Batik Air told the government they would only take over AirAsia's operations on a large scale if they could also assume its aircraft leases, one of the people said, as absorbing its routes and passenger volumes without the aircraft would be far more difficult. Malaysia Airlines and Batik Air have both expressed to the government their willingness to expand organically to absorb AirAsia's routes and passengers rather than acquire its whole business, the people said. AirAsia has said it commands about 40 per cent of Malaysia's overall aviation market and 60 per cent of domestic flying, making its financial challenges a significant concern for the government, the people interviewed by Reuters said. Farouk Kamal, deputy group CEO of AirAsia Group, said in a statement that the airline does not comment on operational or financial speculation or unannounced corporate arrangements. "All material updates regarding our business and fleet strategy are disclosed transparently through official exchange filings and corporate announcements at the appropriate time," he told Reuters. "We also wish to reiterate that AirAsia remains focused on maintaining business continuity and stable operations across all its markets and we continue to see strong underlying demand across our network. We are also working closely with our stakeholders to manage our financial and operational requirements." Malaysia Airports Holdings said it regularly engaged with all airline partners as part of normal network and route development, including on "potential capacity and route opportunities where there are gaps in the market or unmet demand." It declined to comment on AirAsia's financial outlook. Malaysia's finance ministry, Batik Air and Malaysia Airlines declined to comment.

AirAsia halts direct flights between Singapore and Jakarta

AirAsia launches first codeshare with Turkey's Pegasus Airlines

AIRASIA SEEKS FRESH CAPITAL AirAsia, which had current liabilities of RM18.4 billion (US$4.55 billion) as of Jun 30, owes Malaysia Airports Holdings at least RM500 million, the people and two others said, for services including landing and parking fees. The airport operator has already granted the carrier repayment extensions, two of them said. They all declined to be identified because the discussions were private. Malaysia Airports Holdings declined to comment on specific queries from Reuters, saying it did not discuss commercial arrangements with airline partners as a matter of practice. AirAsia did not address queries on whether it owed money to Malaysia Airports Holdings but said it had a strong and constructive relationship with key partners, including Malaysia Airports Holdings Chief Airports Officer Bryan Thompson and his team. AirAsia said this month it was advancing discussions with financial institutions, targeting up to US$1 billion from international debt markets plus RM700 million in local credit facilities, primarily to restructure its debt. Two of the people with knowledge of the matter estimated the airline required at least US$3 billion of fresh capital to address its financial position. In response, AirAsia said its financing targets were sufficient to meet its requirements. The airline had cash and bank balances of RM954 million as of Jun 30. AirAsia reported a net loss of RM831 million for the second quarter ended Jun 30, hit by rising jet fuel costs and heavy foreign-exchange losses of RM331 million. The carrier has been restructuring aggressively, cutting underperforming routes, returning 25 older aircraft to lessors and renegotiating contracts with vendors to reduce costs. Reuters reported this month that the finance ministry had hired Alton Aviation Consultancy to assess AirAsia's funding needs as it weighs whether to provide support given the airline's role as a major employer and provider of affordable air connectivity across the region. The finance ministry declined to comment, while Alton did not respond to a request for comment.

Source: Reuters/bg

item.title: US court accepts airBaltic Chapter 11 filing, Latvian prime minister says
item.description: A U.S. court judge has accepted Latvian carrier airBaltic's request to enter Chapter 11 under the U.S. bankruptcy code and restructure its debt, Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A U.S. court judge has accepted Latvian carrier airBaltic's request to enter Chapter 11 under the U.S. bankruptcy code and restructure its debt, Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs said on Wednesday. "This means that airBaltic will be able to: immediately access financing; begin the restructuring process; review obligations to creditors. Work continues," Kulbergs said in a post on social media X. The airline did not immediately reply to a request for comment. AirBaltic, majority-owned by the Latvian government, [USN:L6N4560BF TEXT:"voluntarily filed"] for protection under Chapter 11 on Monday as it seeks to cut its debt pile after the Iran war increased financial pressure. The company has said it secured a commitment for €350 million ($404.1 million) in financing from certain lenders, subject to court approval. In the coming months, airBaltic is expected to negotiate with bondholders, aircraft lessors and other creditors as it works toward a formal reorganisation plan, which will require separate court approval before the company can exit Chapter 11. The airline has said it aims to complete the process by around June 2027, with a [USN:L6N456122 TEXT:"reduced fleet"] and lower operating costs as part of its longer-term business plan. ($1 = 0.8661 euros)

item.title: WH Smith expects annual profit at lower end of forecast
item.description: British retailer WH Smith said on Wednesday it expects annual profit at the lower end of its earlier forecast range, as margins were squeezed by inflation turbo-charged by the Iran war and higher promotional activity.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British retailer WH Smith (SMWH.L) said on Wednesday it expects annual profit at the lower end of its earlier forecast range, as margins were squeezed by inflation turbo-charged by the Iran war and higher promotional activity. The company is reviewing its North American operations and shutting underperforming stores in a turnaround effort after cutting its profit forecast [USN:L6N42I0CU TEXT:"twice in two months"] and raising capital earlier this year as the war hit travel and passenger spending. WH Smith, which sells everything from books to travel accessories and confectionery, expects headline pre-tax profit of about £75 million ($101 million) for the year ended August 31, compared with its earlier view of between £75 million and £90 million. Its like-for-like sales in North America fell 3% in the fourth quarter, reflecting lower passenger volumes and softer demand, while sales in the UK grew 4%. ($1 = 0.7418 pounds)

item.title: 米ロサンゼルスでNBCヘリが墜落、3人死亡 事故現場取材中
item.description:
NBCロサンゼルスは15日、ロサンゼルスのチャッツワース地区で同局のニュースヘリコプターが同日夜に墜落し、3人が死亡、1人が負傷したと報じた。
ロサンゼルス消防局によると、墜落現場で確認された4人のうち、3人は死亡、1人は容体が不明のまま地元の病院へ搬送された。
NBCのキャスターは、墜落したヘリコプターに何人が搭乗していたかには言及しなかった。
消防局によると、国家運輸安全委員会（NTSB）と連邦航空局（FAA）が墜落事故の調査を行うという。
ヘリコプターが墜落したチャッツワース地区ではこの日、バスと乗用車の衝突事故が起きていた。この衝突事故で少なくとも2人が死亡した。
複数のメディア報道によると、NBCのヘリコプターが墜落した際、衝突事故の取材のために数機の報道用ヘリコプターが現場付近に飛来していた。
米コムキャスト傘下のNBCとロサンゼルス消防局は、詳細に関する問い合わせに直ちには応じていない。

item.title: Caute in attesa decisione Fed, greggio in calo
item.description: I mercati azionari asiatici sono cauti, sostenuti dalla tregua nel massiccio sell-off obbligazionario globale e dal calo dei prezzi del greggio, elementi che hanno contribuito a placare i timori in vista della decisione della Federal Reserve di oggi.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: I mercati azionari asiatici sono cauti, sostenuti dalla tregua nel massiccio sell-off obbligazionario globale e dal calo dei prezzi del greggio, elementi che hanno contribuito a placare i timori in vista della decisione della Federal Reserve di oggi. ** L’indice più ampio MSCI relativo ai titoli dell’Asia-Pacifico escluso il Giappone (.MISX00000PUS) cede l'1,2% in chiusura di seduta, nonostante i rialzi dei titoli coreani (.KS11) e di quelli taiwanesi (.TWII) . Il Nikkei sale dello 0,3%, mentre i futures e-mini sull’S&P 500 registrano un rialzo dello 0,23%. ** Sul fronte obbligazionario, il rendimento dei titoli del Treasury a 10 anni rimane stabile al 4,9938% dopo aver sfiorato la soglia del 5%, superata ieri per la prima volta da tre anni. Nel corso della giornata la Fed comunicherà la propria decisione di politica monetaria, a cui farà seguito la conferenza stampa del presidente Kevin Warsh. ** Gli operatori ritengono che una stretta da parte della Federal Reserve sia quasi certa, scontando una probabilità implicita del 93% di un rialzo di 25 punti base, in netto aumento rispetto al 61,2% di una settimana fa. ** I prezzi del greggio arretrano nelle contrattazioni asiatiche, con i futures sul Brent in ribasso dello 0,65% a 108,04 dollari il barile, dopo il balzo del 2,9% di ieri, quando fonti del settore marittimo avevano riferito che le operazioni di carico del greggio presso l’hub di esportazione saudita di Yanbu, sul Mar Rosso, erano state sospese e che Riyadh aveva annullato alcune consegne di carico ai clienti europei.

item.title: El regulador de datos español informa sobre un acceso indebido relacionado con un agente de IA
item.description: La Agencia Española de Protección de Datos dijo que había recibido la primera notificación de una violación de la seguridad de datos personales presuntamente llevada a cabo por un agente de inteligencia artificial, un caso que apunta a que los sistemas autónomos están empezando a desempeñar un papel directo en los ciberataques.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Agencia Española de Protección de Datos dijo que había recibido la primera notificación de una violación de la seguridad de datos personales presuntamente llevada a cabo por un agente de inteligencia artificial, un caso que apunta a que los sistemas autónomos están empezando a desempeñar un papel directo en los ciberataques. La Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (AEPD) dijo el lunes en una entrada de su blog que el incidente se produjo cuando un agente de IA utilizó un gran modelo de lenguaje muy conocido para identificar vulnerabilidades, acceder a un sistema y, posteriormente, modificar datos personales y acceder a facturas. La agencia señaló que la supuesta vulneración le fue comunicada por la organización afectada y que la información sigue siendo objeto de análisis, y añadió que el uso de un modelo concreto de IA no significaba que ni el modelo en sí ni la infraestructura de su proveedor se hubieran visto comprometidos, ni que la tecnología se hubiera desarrollado con fines maliciosos. La AEPD no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios de Reuters, ni identificó el modelo extenso de lenguaje ni la organización afectada por la violación de la seguridad de los datos. La agencia señaló que el caso era relevante porque, al parecer, un tercero utilizó un agente de IA para llevar a cabo varias fases de un ataque con una intervención humana limitada, lo que pone de relieve el papel cada vez más importante de los sistemas autónomos en los incidentes de ciberseguridad. El incidente se produce en un momento en que los reguladores y las autoridades de ciberseguridad de Estados Unidos y Europa están intensificando el escrutinio de los riesgos que plantean los sistemas de IA, cada vez más capaces, a pesar de que las empresas están adoptando esta tecnología a un ritmo vertiginoso. PRIORIZAR LA SEGURIDAD PÚBLICA España [USN:L6N41Q0G7 TEXT:"se ha posicionado"] como uno de los defensores más activos de Europa de un modelo de "IA confiable" que proteja la privacidad, la democracia, a los menores y la seguridad pública, en lugar de dar prioridad a la rapidez o al beneficio de la industria tecnológica. Aunque un solo caso no basta para establecer una tendencia más amplia, la notificación indica que los ataques asistidos por IA podrían estar dejando atrás la etapa teórica y comenzando a afectar al tratamiento de datos personales en el mundo real, añadió la AEPD. Según la notificación presentada por la organización afectada, el agente logró acceder al sistema antes de buscar de forma autónoma puntos débiles en la aplicación. Tras identificar una vulnerabilidad, fue capaz de alterar información personal y consultar registros de facturación. El organismo regulador español no ha indicado cuándo finalizará la investigación de la infracción notificada. La agencia señaló que la IA no crea nuevas amenazas. Sin embargo, aumenta la velocidad, la escala y la adaptabilidad de las técnicas maliciosas existentes, lo que reduce el tiempo disponible para detectarlas y contenerlas. Los responsables del tratamiento, los encargados del tratamiento y los delegados de protección de datos deben prepararse para un escenario en el que la velocidad de los ataques seguirá aumentando, añadió la agencia.
